title: Office and base yard facilities.
bodyText: The council shall provide necessary office and base yard space and facilities for the use and occupancy of the board of water supply.
bodyHtml: §54-32  Office and base yard facilities.  The council shall provide necessary office and base yard space and facilities for the use and occupancy of the board of water supply. [L 1961, c 155, pt of §1; Supp, §145A-22; HRS §54-32]
